tagline: The Stellarium planetarium in your browser on a fast Selkies web desktop: pan the sky, zoom a nebula, scrub through time, no VNC client.
description: Stellarium, the free, open-source desktop planetarium, on a Selkies web desktop. Explore a photorealistic real-time sky in your browser: no VNC client, no local install. There is no maintained browser-desktop build of the actual Stellarium application ("Stellarium Web" is a separate, much lighter reimplementation), so this fills a genuine gap: a modern Selkies (WebRTC) build of the real thing for amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: Stellarium
